talkwheel.jaymoskingdoms.jaymoskingdoms_: I know what you suspect. Let me drink, and I'll make it worth your while.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ask_drink.y: Bring me what I like and I won't say no. Quick, then. And not a word.
That's just the thing I wanted. Fine. Take a little, and take it gently.
A fair trade. Be quick about it.
Put the coin down first. Now, a little. No more.
I'll not say what I'm doing this for. Take it and go.
You've been good to me. Go on, a little. Call it a favour.
I won't ask anything for it. Just keep it between us.
For a friend. Only a little, now.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ask_drink.n: No. Not for that, not for anything.
I won't. Don't ask me again.
You'll find nobody here for that. Go away.
And what do I get for it? Nothing? No.
Come back with something worth my while. Or don't come back.
Asking for a favour from a stranger? No.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ask_drink.r: I'll tell the watch what you are. See if I don't.
Get away from me! They'll all hear of this!
Heaven protect us. Someone must be told.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ask_drink.a: Not again so soon. I'm still dizzy.
You've had your share today. Come back tomorrow.
I can't stand yet. Let me be.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.let_drink.0: Evening, %1$s. I still feel the hollow where you drank. Be good to me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.let_drink.1: You were gentle, %1$s. I haven't told anyone.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.let_drink.2: Not a word of what I gave you, %1$s. And I won't forget it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.refused_drink.0: You asked me for my blood, %1$s. I haven't forgotten.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.refused_drink.1: Stay back, %1$s. You asked what you asked.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.refused_drink.2: I said no to you once, %1$s, and I'd say it again.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.250: A vampire who holds someone by the throat with a glass bottle in the off hand fills it with their blood. A bottle remembers whose blood it is, and so does the blood: Frostborn is cold, Emberborn warm, and a king's gives twice over.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.251: A villager who knows, or half-knows, what you are may let you drink, for coin or for what they want. Ask in their talk menu. Those who refuse remember it, and the timid and the devout may tell.
